meta.name: add-webex
meta.description: Add Webex channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Webex 聊天通道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在应用中添加 Webex 消息功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Webex chat channel into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Webex messaging to your application

howto.what: 装上后,系统会新增 Webex 通道:自动复制适配器、注册通道、安装依赖并验证构建,然后引导你填入机器人令牌和 Webhook 密钥;完成这些后,Webex 空间或私聊消息即可接入。
howto.when: 当你要接入 Webex,或在 /setup 初始化、/manage-channels 管理通道时,会用到这个技能。

say.text: 帮我把 Webex 聊天通道加上。
say.note: 开始执行添加通道的步骤。

say.text: 接入 Webex 机器人,配置令牌和 webhook。
我要在 Webex 上接收消息,帮我配好。
say.note: 会引导完成 Webex 集成。

howto.what_en: Adds Webex channel support: copies the Webex adapter, registers it, installs the pinned dependency, builds/tests, and prompts for the bot token and webhook secret. After setup, Webex spaces or DMs can be wired in.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add Webex integration, or during /setup or /manage-channels flows when a chat channel needs to be added.

say_en.text: Set up Webex bot credentials and webhook.
say_en.note: Prompts for token and secret, writes them to .env.

say_en.text: I want to receive messages in Webex, help me configure it.
